# Accepted, reachable vulnerabilities for `make vuln-check`
# (.github/scripts/vuln-check.sh). One per line:
#   <OSV id> <expires YYYY-MM-DD> <reason>
# An entry stops applying on its expiry date, so CI fails again and the
# exception has to be re-justified or the dependency upgraded. Keep this short.

# google.golang.org/grpc server panic on a request missing :authority/Host.
# Fixed only in grpc pre-release builds (v1.85.0-dev); no released version
# yet. Mitigated: the NetworkPolicy admits only Envoy to the gRPC port, and
# Envoy always sends :authority. Upgrade to grpc v1.85.0 when it ships.
GO-2026-6443 2026-11-15 grpc server panic, no released fix; ingress limited to Envoy
